'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Angelo Consoli LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet, deck name WHT(v). Ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox. Line 47 is written Shady Jedi Combo (no matching printed combo; left as written).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
